oracle.method: Vehtari 2021 sections 3.1-4.3; full initial positive/monotone pair sums including the final complete pair, without odd/even truncation averaging; 60-digit Decimal covariance arithmetic and public SciPy normal scores.
oracle.limitations: Marginal scalar diagnostics on fixed chains. Drop the last draw for odd lengths. Constant tail indicators fail closed with zero ESS. No convergence proof or posterior/calibration license.

reference_review.scope: Retained frozen-chain reference construction and consuming numerical assertions. ArviZ API outputs and the independently evaluated full-pair primary target are kept distinct.
reference_review.independence_basis: Public ArviZ APIs reproduce their own outputs. The separate primary reference evaluates the published rank/fold, variance, positive/monotone-pair and CDF-indicator equations using SciPy ranks/normal scores and 60-digit Decimal covariance sums. Product source was inspected during the audit but no product algorithm/helper is imported or executed; no upstream implementation or tests were consulted or copied. reference_compare performs comparison only.
reference_review.historical_exposure: Historical chain input authorship and prior exposure cannot be independently reconstructed from the retained metadata. Existing inputs and original oracle metadata are preserved; the new tied-tail and odd-draw inputs are deterministic repository-authored constructions.
reference_review.redistribution: Retained reference harness and new deterministic inputs are MIT OR Apache-2.0. Primary papers and API documentation are linked without copying their implementation or text. Numerical outputs are retained; upstream packages stay in the isolated lock environment, outside the product runtime and ordinary CI.
reference_review.limitations: Marginal scalar diagnostics on fixed chains. Drop the last draw for odd lengths. Constant tail indicators fail closed with zero ESS. No convergence proof or posterior/calibration license.
